services.name: Full Moon Party Cruise with OutLife757
services.desc: Duration > - 2 Hours Description Set sail on board the American Rover for the 8th Annual Outlife757 Moon Light Party Cruise. DJ Chris Bird (Best of GAYHRVA Reader's Poll Winner) will be spinning. Enjoy cold drinks and community under the stars! Cruise departs from Waterside Marina in Downtown Norfolk on the waterfront behind the Waterside District. Boarding begins at 10 p.m. Ages 21 and up

services.name: 2 Hour Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Duration > - 2 Hours Description This daytime cruise is our most popular for children and families. Lend a hand setting the sails, take a turn at the helm, or simply sit back and enjoy the cruise as the Captain Points out the highlights of the Harbor: The Downtown Norfolk and Portsmouth Skylines, Battleship Wisconsin, Private Shipyards and more. services.name: July 4th Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Duration >• 2.5 Hours Description Beat the crowds and Experience the July 4th Fireworks from the best Vantage Point of all – after a tour of the Harbor we will position the ship to give you an incredible view of the region’s best fireworks show! Enjoy music onboard with an acoustic guitarist! July 4th, 7:30-10:00 PM If the Fireworks are cancelled you will just be charged the regular Sunset Cruise

services.name: Out on the Boat - Pride Boat Parade
services.desc: Duration > - 1 1/2 Hours Description Before you attend Pride Fest in Town Point Park join us for “Out on the Boat” for the Pride Boat Parade! You will be part of the only pride boat parade in the country! Join us aboard the American Rover for a 1 1/2 Hour Cruise on the Smooth Waters of the Elizabeth River & Hampton Roads Harbor.
